messages.text:
"Create a completely NEW fantasy MMORPG project called AETHERIA from scratch. Build a fully playable game with detailed 3D graphics and a fixed isometric camera angled diagonally from above. The camera follows the player while keeping its angle and distance fixed. Use detailed 3D characters, monsters, environments, buildings, weapons, lighting, shadows and smooth animations. Keep characters relatively small on screen so players can see a large area of the world.

WORLD:
Create a large fantasy world with two factions: Angels and Demons. Include these regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Include the settlements Dawnshire, Stonewatch, Sunmarket and Frosthaven. Use separate large maps with loading transitions.

CHARACTERS AND CLASSES:
Character creation with male and female characters, different hairstyles, eye colors and cosmetic appearances. Include 3 distinct playable classes with unique weapons, armor, normal attacks and powerful skills. Main skills can be upgraded to level 10. Angels have celestial wings and Demons have demonic wings.

COMBAT AND MONSTERS:
Real-time combat, normal attacks, class skills, auto-attack, HP and MP, potions, monster respawns, rare monsters, world events, dungeons and boss fights. Include wolves, boars, bears, bandits, orcs, shamans, giant spiders, spider queens, skeletons, ghosts, undead knights, dark mages, ice monsters, frost warriors, scorpions and demons.

EQUIPMENT AND LOOT:
Include 9 equipment slots, class and level restrictions, equipment stats and item rarities. All directly dropped equipment must always be T3. Drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. Purple and higher rarities must never drop directly.

FUSION:
Combine 4 identical items of the same class, type, rarity and tier. T3 becomes T2, T2 becomes T1, and T1 upgrades to the next rarity at T3. Never randomly destroy items. Legendary equipment must be crafted using rare materials, boss drops and recipes. Mythic requires 4 matching Legendary items. Divine requires 4 matching Mythic items. Mythic and Divine must never drop directly.

CRAFTING AND ECONOMY:
Include gathering, crafting, recipes, materials, blacksmiths, merchants, storage, gold and gems. Include configurable prices for crafting, fusion, repairs, potions and teleportation. Add a player marketplace where unwanted equipment can be sold. Players can obtain equipment for every class. Boss stones can have up to 3 bonuses. Maximum critical chance is 50%.

QUESTS AND NPCS:
Include main quests, side quests, rewards and interactive NPCs. The starting village must have a blacksmith, merchant, quest NPC, storage NPC and teleporter.

WINGS AND SHOP:
Wings can only be obtained through quests or optional purchases. They never drop from monsters, cannot be traded and cannot be fused. Include a cosmetic shop with costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, faction wings, gems and optional premium membership. Keep the game free-to-play. Gems must also be obtainable through gameplay.

MOBILE UI:
Create mobile-friendly controls with a virtual joystick, attack button, skill buttons, interaction button, mount, auto-attack, HP/MP bars, minimap, inventory, equipment, quests, shop and menus. All game text and UI must be in English.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Build a real playable game, not just a concept or mockup. Use modular code and a central configuration for game balance. Prepare the architecture for future online multiplayer, player accounts, persistent character data, secure trading and server-authoritative combat, inventory, currencies and purchases. Do not pretend local simulation is real multiplayer. Test movement, combat, skills, quests, crafting, fusion, equipment, drops, NPCs, travel and saving. Fix errors before finishing.

Build the 3D world and a representative playable area first, then expand the remaining regions and systems. Preserve all the gameplay features described above. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
